title: Peacock International Strut
lyrics:
5. Peacock International Strut
Concept: High-energy funky world-brass parade with Latin, African, and Caribbean influences — pure celebratory swagger.
Suno Prompt: Instrumental only. Funky international brass parade blending New Orleans-style brass, Latin percussion, African soukous guitar, and Caribbean steelpan accents over tight modern funk bass and drums. Structure: 0:00 bold brass fanfare intro, 0:30 infectious strutting groove locks, 1:15 playful breakdown with quirky brass stabs and percussive comedy, 2:00 massive full-band drop, 2:45 extended funky outro with trading solos. Professional punchy and polished. Confident, joyful, free-moving energy. 336 Hz anchored. Demonstrates Suno’s excellence in brass arrangement, rhythmic pocket, and joyful global fusion.
